column7: The per-IP login budget failed OPEN on LoginAttempt storage errors (IsLoginRateLimited false, Record/Reserve recorded nothing), so a DB fault removed the brute-force backstop. Andrei 2026-10-10: neither open nor closed; fall back to a bounded in-memory per-IP limiter with the same limit and window, audited (auth.rate_limit_error) and counted (keyorix_auth_rate_limit_fallback_total{budget="login"}, renamed from keyorix_login_budget_fallback_total in item 5). HTTP: TestLoginBudget_StorageDownStillRefusesWithTheSame429 (red when rate_limit.go is reverted: the 11th login succeeds; green: byte-identical 429). Bound: TestLoginBudgetFallback_BoundedUnderManyDistinctIPs (mutation-killed by disabling LRU eviction).
